prompt:
Create ONE 1672x941 landscape cinematic luxury fashion shopping-editorial image by editing the provided scene. Reference 1 is the PRIMARY PROTECTED HUMAN AND GARMENT SOURCE. Reference 2 is the SIGNATURE COLLECTION HERO ENVIRONMENT AND BRAND-WORLD authority. References 3 and 4 are LIGHTING/PHYSICAL INTEGRATION/MOOD inspiration only; do not import their people, outfits, Black Rose wording, sculptures, or concrete setting.
THE TASK: Keep the original three-person Signature ensemble, their actual identities and all five visible products from reference 1, and place that same ensemble authentically into a full-width environment inspired closely by reference 2. This is the third Signature Scroll World commerce scene, NOT a standalone collection hero. The models and products lead the image; monumental architecture supports them.
PROTECTED CAST: same young adult man at left with textured short hair, ear stud, existing arm tattoo and smile looking toward the women; same center woman with curly high ponytail, small earrings and layered necklaces, smiling toward the right; same right woman with loose curly hair, smiling back toward center. Preserve the exact faces, natural skin tones, ethnic appearance, proportions, body shapes, expressions, gazes, relaxed original hand placements and original left-center-right order. Preserve their friendly shared moment and social connection; do not replace it with stern disconnected runway poses. Keep all three full-length, with outer models' existing white sneakers and socks visible, generous headroom and no clipped shoes.
PROTECTED PRODUCTS, COPY FROM REFERENCE 1 WITHOUT INVENTION: left man exact white tee with blue rose/bridge/cloud chest graphic; exact blue-waistband shorts with white drawstrings, DAYTIME BAY BRIDGE all-over print and blue rose/cloud detail near the bottom. Center woman exact coordinated WHITE pastel windbreaker jacket AND matching full-length pants, one complete set: pink hood lining, precise diagonal pastel pink/yellow/mint/lavender stripe geometry on chest, cuffs, hem and legs; existing pink rose logo positions, white zipper, pockets, material and folds. Right woman exact white tee with purple rose/Golden Gate/cloud artwork; exact PURPLE-waistband shorts with white drawstrings, NIGHTTIME GOLDEN GATE BRIDGE all-over print and purple rose/cloud detail near the bottom; existing white socks and shoes. Do not recolor, erase, relocate or simplify artwork. Keep tees white. DO NOT change the left shorts' Bay Bridge into Golden Gate simply because the environment is Golden Gate. Do not swap the two bridge prints, change waistbands, convert windbreaker pants to shorts, shorten garments, invent zippers, remove pockets or add new logos. Clothing must stay highly readable with complete visible hems and front artwork.
ENVIRONMENT: replace the source's casual sunny wooden-pier setting with a Signature monument terrace that clearly belongs to reference 2: its recognizable Golden Gate identity, warm rose-gold/gold material language, monumental sculptural craft, dark polished stone and water reflections, atmospheric Bay depth and cinematic evening light. Extend that exact hero's world into a physically inhabitable shopping-editorial courtyard, not a generic luxury lobby or unrelated urban scene. Golden Gate tower geometry must be Golden Gate, not the Bay Bridge. Use the hero reference's monumental design vocabulary in the middle distance, especially a restrained existing rose-gold/gold brand sculpture positioned right of or behind the ensemble. Preserve the hero's sculpture design and any lettering rather than inventing a new logo. Keep it supporting in scale, never covering garments or dominating the faces. No Black Rose wording or borrowed text sculptures from references 3/4. Composition: the three-person ensemble is one coherent, prominent foreground group spanning the central-left majority; architectural/bridge depth breathes around them, with right-side negative space and the monument as secondary focus. Do not cut the source into three isolated people or change their relative natural overlaps.
PHYSICAL INTEGRATION IS THE MAIN QUALITY TARGET: shoot people and architecture as ONE photograph with a consistent normal-lens perspective and eye-level camera. Choose hero-consistent late golden-to-blue-hour light with a controlled warm-neutral three-quarter key illuminating faces and product fronts; cooler open-sky fill and gentle rose-gold reflected bounce from actual environmental surfaces. Preserve nuanced skin and exact white/pastel/blue/purple apparel colors. Motivated falloff, shadow softness and highlight direction agree across all three models and the terrace. No studio cutout illumination, bright alpha outline, halos, hard pasted edges, excessive rim glow or orange-teal filter. Match detail, grain and optical sharpness. Create tight sole-shaped contact occlusion underneath the existing outer shoes, realistic weight on the horizontal floor, cast shadows coherent with the key, and subtle fragmented lower-leg/shoe reflections on damp polished stone. Do not add generic ellipse shadows or perfect mirrored duplicate bodies. Source center woman's feet are obscured by the foreground crate: retain a small, low, naturally integrated dark-stone and rose-gold plinth in the same occlusion role so no hidden anatomy or new footwear must be fabricated. The original paper scroll and wooden crate may be replaced by that understated environmental foreground element; it must not obscure any additional garment. No added giant text banner.
ATMOSPHERE AND EDITORIAL FEEL: take references 3/4's dimensional, physically photographed cinematic presence, the interplay of wet-floor highlights and sculpted skin, restrained depth haze behind people, rich tactile cloth and believable stone/metal response. Add only subtle distance haze and controlled practical reflections. Keep garment fronts, faces, hems and shoe contacts unobscured. The scene feels alive through warm human connection, directional light and depth, not smoke-machine fog, glitter, decorative clutter or invented action. This is an authentic, premium shoppable Signature campaign frame in the exact hero-inspired world. Not a collage, not a re-cast lookbook, not a generic background swap. Preserve the primary source's exact identities and garment content as faithfully as possible while changing and integrating its environment.
